values.note: Non-electric sites $20 a night, electric $30 (township rate sheet, Nov 2024; the township's Firefly booking page quoted the same for 2026-10-25). Rustic winter camping Oct 1 until spring opening at a reduced price (amount not posted). $3.50 reservation fee, not refunded on cancellation. No resident/non-resident split posted.

values.note: Full season from the week before Memorial Day weekend; showers close September 30, and rustic winter camping is allowed at a reduced price from October 1 until the spring opening.

values.note: 12 non-electric sites (1-12) and 5 electric (14-18; there is no site 13). Sites 1-4 and 7 are tent-only (7 is walk-in); RV-capable sites per the booking page: 5, 6, 9, 10 up to 20 ft, 8, 11, 12 and electric 14-16 up to 25 ft, ADA electric sites 17-18 (concrete pads) up to 28 ft. Four people per site (single families or youth groups may be larger).

values.note: Hand pump near the rustic sites and a cold-water spigot by the showers; two pit toilets plus portable toilets (one ADA); four enclosed outdoor hot showers, free to campers. Campground host on site; some firewood on hand (bringing firewood to the island is unlawful).

values.note: Booked online on the township's Firefly Reservations page, or through the campground host at 231-497-4477. Full refund of site fees for cancellations two weeks or more before arrival (by email to the host). A vehicle needs its own Beaver Island Boat Co. ferry reservation, which the township says to secure first.

booking.source: https://webgen1files1.revize.com/stjamestwpmi/Campground%20WEBSITE%20Update%2011-1-24.pdf ('To access the St. James Campground Reservation System please click on the following link: https://app.fireflyreservations.com/Reserve/Property/StJamesTownshipCampground'; 'The total number of days must not exceed thirty (30) days.') + https://stjamestwp.org/st_james_township_campground/http___stjamestwp.org_government_departments_st_james_township_campground_index.php ('Campground Host Phone Number: 231 497-4477'; CANCELATION POLICY) + the Firefly page itself, read 2026-10-25

note: St. James Township campground on a bluff overlooking Lake Michigan and Garden, Squaw and Whiskey Islands, just off Donegal Bay Rd about a mile from the St. James ferry dock at the end of the bike path; a short walk to town and the Donegal Bay swimming beach. Beaver Island is reached only by the Beaver Island Boat Co. car ferry from Charlevoix. Dark-sky viewing area; take care near the bluff. --Claude
summary: Township pages + Nov 2024 rate sheet + its Firefly booking engine (2026 quote): $20 non-electric / $30 electric (confirmed, now 2026), $3.50 reservation fee, reservable online (Firefly) with a 30-day max (confirmed), potable water/pit toilets/showers (confirmed). Changed sites 18 -> 17 (12 non-electric + 5 electric; the camping page says 11 + 6), added max rig 28 ft (ADA sites 17-18; 25 ft at sites 8, 11, 12, 14-16). Season added as year-round (full season late May - Sep 30, reduced-rate rustic winter camping after). Electric amperage not stated. Phone matches the host's number.
flags: Ferry (for AWH to decide): Beaver Island Boat Co. (bibco.com, 231-547-2311). Its 'Vehicle Restrictions' page: the EMERALD ISLE takes 'no more than 50 tons GVW and no more than 4,500 lbs per tire', 'Height restriction of 13 feet 6 inches', 'Length restriction of 46 feet, forward of that 46 feet the height restriction drops down to a maximum of 7'6"'; the BEAVER ISLANDER is limited to 7'6" in a small area and 6'4" elsewhere (so a 10-ft motorhome can only go on the Emerald Isle). 'Vehicle reservations are required for all vehicles' (by phone). 2026 fare table, one-way: 'Vehicle (over 7'6" tall, 10' long & above) $110.41+' (roundtrip $220.82+), with 'Please call us with overall dimensions for accurate price' (the '+' is length-based; the 23-ft price is not posted), passenger fare extra ('Adult $33.50' one-way). On those figures a ~23-ft, ~10-ft, ~11,000-lb motorhome is within the Emerald Isle's posted limits.

Website: the first link https://stjamestwp.org/st_james_township_campground/ returns HTTP 403 (2026-10-25). The township's working pages are https://stjamestwp.org/beaches,_parks_and_trails/camping.php and https://stjamestwp.org/st_james_township_campground/http___stjamestwp.org_government_departments_st_james_township_campground_index.php; the booking page is https://app.fireflyreservations.com/Reserve/Property/StJamesTownshipCampground. The Nov 2024 PDF link still works.
Rig fit: only 8 RV-capable sites take 25 ft or more (8, 11, 12, 14-16 at 25 ft; 17-18 at 28 ft); sites 5, 6, 9, 10 cap at 20 ft.
